---

### violations

A disabled profile advertises zero tools to any connected client.

Contentstack advertises this argument only on tools that target a stack.

### exemptions

The runtime exposes the profile's tools, and the client discovers them.

A stack that belongs to another region is unreachable on that session.

The organization owns the stack, so the session resolves its endpoints.

The model reads the input schema and interprets the tool description.

The request cannot reach the endpoint behind a corporate proxy.
